description: We're putting up a three-storey walk-up with two apartments on each floor, six in total, about 280 m2 per floor. We'd like just one interior stair from the top floor down, plus each upper unit gets a balcony. Is one stair acceptable if we add something else?

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form

gold.departure: Third storey served by a single exit; the single-exit allowance covers only 1- and 2-storey buildings.

should_cite.why: single-exit allowance and its storey limit
balcony provision for travel limits within dwelling units

gold.engineering_reason: Six dwelling units exceeds the four-unit exemption.
